subject.title: fix: plugins update rewrites config for install-record-only updates

question: Should install-record-only updates commit SQLite without rewriting config and notify a running Gateway through the new local operator.admin plugins.refresh method, with restart fallback for older or offline Gateways?
rationale: This changes config/index atomicity and adds an additive control-plane contract; tests establish correctness, but maintainers must own the intended mixed-version and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Accept the bounded design
options.body: Land after rebasing and required checks because the branch preserves config-write safety, rollback, and restart fallback while avoiding artificial file writes.

options.title: Require restart-only activation
options.body: Remove the refresh RPC and make every records-only update require an explicit Gateway restart, reducing protocol surface but worsening the running-Gateway workflow.

options.title: Pause for broader persistence redesign
options.body: Hold this fix if owners want plugin update, config mutation, and metadata activation redesigned as one larger transaction boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded design
recommendation.body: Land after rebasing and required checks because the branch preserves config-write safety, rollback, and restart fallback while avoiding artificial file writes.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and authored the latest commits defining the Gateway refresh and generated protocol shape.
